messages:
andrea: quick check — where do we stand on the KV prefetch + continuous-batching milestone for this sprint? need owners and any blocking deps.

sam: kernel side: branch merged to main last night, perf diff looks promising (p50 down ~12%, p95 down ~9%). PR #4927 is ready for final review.

mohit: I can take owner for the warmup logic + metrics dashboard. I still need eng-infra to confirm the canary pool size. @infra-bot any updates?

infra-bot: infra-note: canary pool currently limited to 3 GPU nodes in us-west-2 due to capacity reservations. Can bump to 6 if backup quota approved (ticket INF-834).

tara: I'm owning eviction heuristics and cache TTL changes. planning to land the TTL opt by EOD tomorrow. no blockers on my side.

lucas: small heads-up: continuous-batching change adds a new config flag `batch.max_idle_ms`. default 8ms. add to dedicated config schema before we flip.

andrea: @sam can you drop the PR link and a 1-line summary for reviewers? also list which integration tests we need run.

sam: PR: https://git.redwood/infra/runtime/pulls/4927 summary: switch to batched-kernel path earlier when KV warmup hit 70% hit rate; added lightweight soak test + metrics export. run: `make smoke && pytest tests/integration/prefetch_smoke.py`

mohit: will wire dashboard alerts: prefetched_kv_hit_rate < 0.6 for >5m -> pager to eng-sre. also will tag the PR with `needs-canary` label.

deploy-bot: canary: rollout started for runtime-canary v3.2.1 -> nodes 3/3 (us-west-2). health checks passing.

qa-bot: QA checklist: add regtest for eviction edge-case (repro in #2056), run end-to-end on dedicated replica. assign to @tara for test case.

sam: pinging @andrea for approval to request extra capacity (INF-834) — need 6 nodes for 2hr soak tomorrow 09:00 UTC.

andrea: approved, file the quota request now. if infra can't, we can reduce to 4 nodes and shorten soak to 45m.

mohit: small config note: when `batch.max_idle_ms` < 5ms, we saw throughput regressions on small-seq workloads. plan: keep default 8ms, add a traffic-aware override for high-concurrency clients.

tara: will add a brief doc blurb to the rollout playbook about TTL tuning and fallback behavior.

sam: requesting reviews from @lucas and @tara on #4927. tagging perf logs in the PR.

lucas: ACK, will review later today. if no blockers I'll approve.

andrea: dependency tracker update: 1) PR #4927 (sam) -> needs 2 reviewers; 2) INF-834 quota -> infra; 3) TTL opt (tara) -> QA + doc; 4) dashboard alerts (mohit) -> SLO/alerting review. aiming to close this milestone by sprint day-4.

mohit: quick command for engineers to repro warmup locally:
```
RUNTIME_ENV=local make start && curl -X POST http://localhost:8080/prefetch -d '{"model":"gpt-medium","prefix":"token-stream"}'
```

andrea: great — thanks everyone. small ask: please add one-line status to the milestone card when you land (or if blocked) so PMs get visibility. will follow up in the AM. :wave:
